TaskDescription: Between-subject, randomized-group cue-based left- vs right-hand motor imagery in immersive VR, comparing an embodied (virtual-hand-illusion) priming group against a non-embodied control group, each with a single MI training run of 40 trials. Trial duration: 10.0s, imagery: 10.0s.
Instructions: Imagine moving the left or right hand following the directional cue while immersed in the virtual-reality environment.
InstitutionName: Instituto Superior Tecnico, Universidade de Lisboa
Description: Motor-imagery EEG plus bipolar EMG, skin temperature and accelerometry from 26 healthy volunteers performing cued left/right-hand motor imagery during embodiment-primed MI-BCI training in virtual reality.
